build_skybox_texture: build a SkyBox entity with a given style to create a skybox texture asset for the LabMaze arena
build_wall_textures: build a WallTextures entity with a given style to create 2D wall texture assets for the LabMaze arena
build_floor_textures: build a FloorTextures entity with a given style to create 2D floor texture assets for the LabMaze arena
get_skybox_mjcf_model: get the MJCF root model from a built SkyBox entity to access the skybox texture configuration
get_wall_texture_list: get the list of 2D texture objects from a built WallTextures entity to inspect available wall textures
